sprint_goal: Fix 9 P3 bugs from combined manual + Codex review affecting site audit accuracy, AEO scoring, crawl deduplication, and API robustness
sprint_status: COMPLETE — 9/9 fixes implemented. 82 new tests, 793 site audit tests passing. Codex-reviewed plan (14 findings, all incorporated). T-SA-25 dropped (already resolved).
constraints: Backward compatibility with existing artifacts
All Pydantic fields must have defaults
LiteLLM wraps all LLM calls in content engine (workers, judges, agents)
v1.0 pipeline preserved as-is — both pipelines coexist via separate API endpoints
ContentBlueprint extends ContentBrief — transparent to all workers
Workers modified in-place (not duplicated) — shared between v1.0 and v1.3
_ensure_litellm_model() auto-prefixes model strings for backward compat
LangGraph >=1.0 interrupt model: check __interrupt__ in result dict, not GraphInterrupt exception
Frontend renders its own charts from raw JSON (not iframes)
No Supabase yet — filesystem artifacts are source of truth
email-validator required for auth models (EmailStr)
Double-underscore separator for effective slugs: {company}__{product}
Default-deny middleware — all routes protected unless explicitly whitelisted
core/ cannot import from api/ — shared code goes in core/shared_tools/
DB layer is opt-in via DATABASE_URL — no engine creation at import time
Repos flush only, DI session generator owns commit/rollback
AuthServiceProtocol is the contract — all routers use get_auth_service dependency
LangSmith is sole tracing backend — Langfuse fully removed
Hub prompts opt-in via langsmith_use_hub=False — local Python prompts authoritative by default
LangGraph span propagation via contextvars (not state injection — MemorySaver crashes)
Section-level feedback is default loop — major direction change only from HITL-3 or semantic < 0.5
